  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos;
  • Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa);
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas);
  • Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas);

title: Mobile Software Engineer – React Native (Mid/Senior)
description:
eNor Securities is a fintech focused on financial infrastructure, digital assets, and regulated products , operating at the intersection of traditional finance and the crypto ecosystem.

We work in a highly complex technical and regulatory environment , building products that require robustness, security, scalability, and clear architecture .

Our engineering team works closely with product and business, making technical decisions with real impact on operations and company growth.

About the role

We are looking for a Mobile Software Engineer with a strong focus on React Native to strategically contribute to the evolution of our mobile applications.

Beyond building screens, we seek someone with strong engineering fundamentals , mobile architectural thinking , and the ability to collaborate closely with backend, product, and design.

You will help build scalable, stable, and high-quality mobile applications , designed to support critical financial products and long-term evolution.


Expected profile
  • Mid to Senior level
  • 5+ years of experience in mobile or frontend development
  • Strong understanding of mobile architecture and state management
  • Comfortable discussing technical trade-offs and proposing solutions
  • Hands-on , collaborative, quality-oriented mindset
  • Technical English required for reading, writing, and professional communication


Required skills
  • Solid experience with React Native
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript
  • Experience with modern mobile architectures and component-based design
  • Familiarity with REST and/or GraphQL APIs
  • Ability to write testable, performant, and maintainable mobile code
  • Understanding of the mobile lifecycle (Android and iOS)


Nice to have
  • State management (Redux, Zustand, MobX, or similar)
  • Modern React / React Native patterns (Hooks, Context, performance optimizations)
  • Mobile testing (Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox, or similar)
  • App publishing and maintenance on App Store and Google Play
  • Native API integrations (native modules, bridges)
  • Mobile CI/CD
  • Familiarity with Expo (and clarity on when to use or not)


Responsibilities
  • Contribute to the architectural evolution of mobile applications
  • Implement features aligned with product and design
  • Propose improvements in performance, stability, and user experience
  • Ensure scalable, testable, and sustainable mobile code
  • Work closely with backend, product, and design teams
  • Support continuous improvement of mobile practices and standards


Differentials
  • Experience in fintech, crypto, or financial products
  • Background in large-scale or complex mobile applications
  • Knowledge of mobile performance, UX, and security best practices
  • Senior engineer mindset with a systemic and product-oriented view


If you enjoy real technical challenges and want to build impactful financial infrastructure, come join eNor Securities.

title: Estagiário
description:
ATENÇÃO


SOMENTE SERÃO ACEITAS CANDIDATURAS CONFORME ORIENTAÇÕES ABAIXO, PORTANTO, LEIA COM CRITÉRIO.


Sobre a UniCarbo:


A UniCarbo é uma empresa brasileira líder no mercado de créditos de carbono do setor de resíduos na América Latina.


Com 20 anos de experiência e projetos em mais de 10 países a UniCarbo é uma one stop shop que atende os principais players do mercado de resíduos.


Combinando expertise no monitoramento e emissão de créditos de carbono, com a operação de projetos, mais do que uma empresa de consultoria, a UniCarbo representa hoje um verdadeiro facilitador de projetos, entregando serviços de alta qualidade.


Ao longo de suas operações nos últimos anos, a UniCarbo esteve diretamente envolvida nos processos de certificação e emissão de mais de 50 Milhões de créditos de carbono principalmente gerados em mais de 100 projetos de biogás de aterros sanitários. Um dos maiores portfólios do mundo. 


 Sobre a vaga:


A UniCarbo cresceu mais de 200% nos últimos 3 anos e procura consolidar um time com competências específicas, oferecendo treinamento com o objetivo de uma posterior integração na equipe.


  • Interesse na área de mudança climática/aquecimento global, Protocolo de Kyoto, Acordo de Paris e convenção sobre mudança climática;
  • Interesse em mecanismos de redução de emissões de gases do efeito estufa (GEEs), Protocolo de Quioto, Acordo de Paris e em outros mercados de carbono;
  • Interesse na caracterização das emissões (medição, monitoramento, cálculos);
  • Interesse no campo das tecnologias ambientalmente corretas para eliminação de resíduos sólidos urbanos, geração de energia (energias renováveis), etc.
  • Bons conhecimentos de ferramentas MS Office (Word, Excel);
  • Boa capacidade analítica;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens de curto prazo a locais de projeto no Brasil e no exterior, mediante planejamento prévio;
  • Disponibilidade para realizar o estágio de 6 horas por dia.

Habilidades de comunicação requeridas:

Todas as atividades são desenvolvidas em língua inglesa, portanto, é essencial uma forte capacidade de comunicação em inglês. Enquanto a maioria das atividades estará relacionada a projetos de redução de emissões localizados não apenas no Brasil, mas também na América do Sul e Central, as habilidades de comunicação em língua espanhola são uma vantagem.

Atividades a serem empreendidas como parte do estágio:


  • Prestação de apoio em atividades relacionadas com o funcionamento e monitoramento de projetos de crédito de carbono;
  • Fornecimento de apoio na compilação de relatórios e ferramentas de cálculo relacionadas a projetos de crédito de carbono;
  • Fornecimento de apoio na revisão, análise de dados e cálculo de projetos de redução de emissões de gases de efeito estufa (GEE);
  • Prestação de apoio na operação de participação em auditorias internas e externas.

ATENÇÃO: NÃO SERÃO ACEITAS CANDIDATURAS POR OUTROS MEIOS EXCETO O DISPONIBILIZADO ABAIXO 


Caso tenha interesse na vaga, preencher formulário:


Bolsa: R$ 1.600,00


Para saber mais sobre nós, acesse:


Site: unicarbo.com.br

Redes Sociais: instagram.com/unicarbo_

title: Analista de dados sênior
description:
Required Qualifications:


  • Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong foundation in marketing analytics , with hands-on experience analyzing multi-channel marketing performance.
  • Advanced SQL expertise , including complex queries over large datasets with performance considerations.
  • Experience working with modern data warehouses such as SQL Server, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, or PostgreSQL.
  • Proven ability to work with multi-source data , including reconciliation and alignment of metrics across systems.
  • Solid understanding of data schemas, grain, and data freshness .
  • Practical experience with attribution models and campaign measurement frameworks .
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into business insights.
  • A data validation and QA mindset , comfortable explaining data issues and discrepancies.


Nice to Have:


  • Experience working closely with Marketing, Growth, or CRM teams.
  • Familiarity with digital advertising platforms (Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, etc.).
  • Experience in fast-paced or data-heavy environments.
  • Strong communication skills and comfort presenting insights to non-technical audiences.

title: Content Quality Specialist (with Advanced English)
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

Content Quality Assurance Analyst/Content Quality Specialist contributes toward ensuring that Carnegie delivers excellence in its key client deliverables. This includes the thorough and timely review of an array of print and digital pieces across Carnegie’s portfolio, ensuring alignment with the company’s best practices and client-provided standards.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Quality Assurance
  • Review copy and design content of all electronic and print materials for spelling, grammatical, and stylistic accuracy and consistency, as well as make detailed comparisons of fonts, colors, images, alignment, and textual content
  • Utilize “best practices” guidelines and ensure all materials adhere to client-provided style guides
  • Functionality Testing
  • Test functionality of electronic materials from an end-user perspective, clicking links in emails and completing online forms and applications to ensure all elements work as intended on both desktop and mobile devices and in multiple email clients
  • Collaboration and Process Improvement
  • Make suggestions to improve processes and workflows, and contribute to the company’s high standards for all client-facing materials
  • Collaborate on improvements to creative content with copy and design team members, as needed
  • Help to improve quality assurance processes and checklists


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Multi-talented – visually and linguistically – with the ability to “see” creative content and design from a variety of perspectives
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience proofing/reviewing and/or creating content and design components of electronic and print materials is a plus
  • Working knowledge of graphic design principles and terminology is a plus
  • Strong attention to detail/consistency, with a keen eye for spotting errors
  • Ability to multitask and manage aggressive deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong organizational and project-management skills
  • Ability to work well independently as well as to collaborate with a team
  • Great appreciation for end-user perception and experience
  • Due to the remote environment, effective communication and time management skills are required, as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Physical requirement: Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods


Credentials and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
  • 2+ years of experience in marketing, communication, design production, technical support or similar
  • Experience in college admissions is a plus
  • Basic knowledge of applicable software including Microsoft Office, Adobe Acrobat, Google Documents, and Apple OS


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos


Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

  • English Advanced



• The role involves designing and executing test plans for enterprise network software solutions, validating performance, reliability, and scalability in Kubernetes-based environments, and developing automation scripts using Bash and Python.

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Sênior (.NET / C#)
description:
Desenvolvedor Backend Sênior (.NET / C#)

Modelo: Remoto

Sobre o desafio Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior para atuar em uma squad estratégica responsável por sistemas críticos de pricing, políticas comerciais, descontos escalonados, contas correntes financeiras, conciliações e integrações corporativas. Você irá trabalhar em um ambiente de alta complexidade, alto volume transacional, forte governança, requisitos de auditoria e integrações distribuídas, suportando múltiplos canais digitais B2B (e-commerce, chatbot, APIs, EDI) e sistemas corporativos como SAP, ServiceNow, motores externos de cálculo e plataformas de dados. O papel exige forte capacidade de engenharia, visão sistêmica, responsabilidade técnica e maturidade para operar em ambiente regulado, com foco em performance, resiliência, observabilidade e escalabilidade. Responsabilidades

Desenvolver e evoluir APIs e serviços backend em C# (.NET) para sistemas de pricing, regras comerciais, incentivos, contas correntes e conciliações financeiras.

Atuar no desenho de arquiteturas cloud-native, orientadas a eventos e microsserviços, garantindo escalabilidade, disponibilidade e tolerância a falhas.

Implementar soluções com foco em: o Alta performance e baixa latência o Idempotência, versionamento, snapshots e rastreabilidade o Consistência de dados e integridade transacional o Observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing distribuído)

Integrar sistemas internos e externos (ex: SAP, plataformas de parceiros, motores de cálculo, mensageria, APIs públicas e privadas).

Trabalhar com bancos relacionais e modelagem de dados complexa (PostgreSQL / SQL Server), incluindo otimização de queries e estratégia de índices.

Garantir padrões de qualidade: o Testes automatizados o Code review o Clean Architecture / SOLID o Segurança e compliance

Atuar em conjunto com Produto, Arquitetura, QA, DevOps e áreas de negócio, participando ativamente de refinamentos técnicos e tomada de decisão.

Apoiar tecnicamente desenvolvedores mais juniores, elevando o nível do time (mentoria técnica).


Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor Backend Sênior com C# e .NET (.NET Core / .NET 8 e 10) Domínio de: o APIs REST o Microsserviços o Arquitetura em camadas / Clean Architecture o Design Patterns

Experiência comprovada com: o Sistemas de alta performance e alto volume o Processamento assíncrono o Mensageria (SQS e SNS) o Controle de concorrência

Experiência com bancos relacionais: o PostgreSQL e SQL Server o Modelagem relacional complexa o Otimização de queries e performance

Experiência em ambientes cloud AWS o Containers o Observabilidade o Monitoramento o Escalabilidade

Práticas de engenharia: o Testes automatizados o Versionamento (Git) o Code review Diferenciais (Nice to Have)

Experiência com: o Sistemas financeiros, pricing, billing, conciliação, ledger, marketplaces ou e-commerce B2B. o Arquitetura orientada a eventos. o Processamento batch e streaming. o Feature toggles, blue-green deploy, canary release.

Conhecimento em: o Domain-Driven Design (DDD) o Event Sourcing / CQRS o Observabilidade avançada (Datadog, OpenTelemetry).

Vivência em ambientes regulados, auditáveis ou com forte governança. Experiência integrando com ERPs (SAP ou similares).

title: A/R Collections Specialist
description:
Position Overview  

We’re seeking a detail-oriented, proactive Accounts Receivable & Collections Specialist to support our finance team. This role is all about maintaining healthy cash flow by efficiently managing invoicing, aging receivables, and customer collections while building strong relationships with clients and internal teams. 

Key Responsibilities  


  • Prepare, issue, and follow up on customer invoices in a timely and accurate manner 
  • Monitor accounts receivable aging reports and prioritize collections activities 
  • Contact customers (email/phone) regarding past-due balances with professionalism and tact 
  • Negotiate payment plans or resolutions while safeguarding company interests 
  • Post customer payments and reconcile accounts 
  • Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies or disputes in coordination with operations and service teams 
  • Maintain documentation of all correspondence and actions taken 
  • Produce weekly/monthly AR status reports for leadership 
  • Collaborate with sales, service, and finance teams to ensure accurate billing and reduce future delinquencies 
  • Suggest process improvements to streamline AR workflows and improve cash conversion 


Qualifications  


  • 2+ years of experience in accounts receivable, billing, or collections 
  • Strong communication skills (clear, persuasive, and professional) 
  • Comfort interacting with customers regarding overdue accounts 
  • Detail-focused with strong organizational/time-management skills 
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities 
  • Proficiency in accounting software and MS Excel 
  • Positive attitude and resilience under pressure 


What Success Looks Like  


  • Faster receivables collection and improved Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) 
  • Fewer overdue accounts and stronger customer payment compliance 
  • Collaborative relationships across teams and with clients 
  • Accurate, timely financial reporting and record-keeping

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Requirements:


  • Fluent English communication, written and spoken.
  • BSc/MSc in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of frontend engineering experience on high-availability, scalable systems.
  • Strong fundamentals in JavaScript (Vanilla JS, OOP, clean code, design patterns) and TypeScript (or proven ability to introduce TS incrementally in legacy codebases).
  • Deep React experience using modern state/data patterns (Redux Toolkit, React Query/SWR, Zustand, Context), with the ability to work within existing Redux/Redux-Saga setups.
  • Excellent HTML5/CSS3 skills (Flexbox, Grid), responsive/mobile-first design, and CSS preprocessors (SASS/LESS).
  • Solid understanding of the JavaScript ecosystem (Node.js, Babel) and modern build tooling (Vite/Webpack; npm/yarn/pnpm).
  • Strong testing discipline with Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright or Cypress; understands TDD principles.
  • Proven experience with performance profiling and optimization (bundle size, rendering, Web Vitals, memory leaks).
  • Strong experience consuming REST APIs and collaborating with backend teams.
  • Comfortable with Git and modern delivery workflows (PRs, code reviews, CI/CD).
  • Hands-on experience using agentic AI coding systems for multi-step engineering tasks.
  • Strong grasp of core agentic AI foundations, including: AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Copilot, Gemini CLI, ChatGPT Codex), Context & memory management, Commands, sub-agents, and MCP servers, Structured outputs (JSON schemas), Function/tool-calling best practices (e.g. CLI tool usage).


Nice to have:


  • Experience with monorepos (Nx, Turborepo).
  • Frontend observability (Sentry, Datadog RUM, OpenTelemetry).
  • Knowledge of Next.js, UI frameworks (Chakra UI).
  • Familiarity with GraphQL and large-scale data systems (RDBMS/NoSQL).
  • Experience with real-time technologies (WebSockets, WebRTC).
  • Service Workers, streaming technologies, and advanced caching.
  • Advanced agentic AI patterns, such as hooks, RAG, cost optimization, self-checking/critique loops, tool mocking for tests, and A/B testing prompts or agents.

title: Business Analyst - Workday
description:
Role Summary:

We are seeking a Senior Workday Business Analyst with strong expertise in Workday Business Processes (BPs) and functional integration knowledge . This is a strategic, functional role — not a technical development position — acting as a bridge between HR business teams, IT development, and QA.

The successful candidate will play a central role in translating business needs into clear process and integration requirements, ensuring alignment between Workday Business Processes and downstream integrations, and coordinating testing cycles to deliver high-quality solutions in a global Workday environment.


Key Responsibilities:

Serve as a functional expert in Workday Business Processes , understanding end-to-end process flows.

Write and maintain Business and System Requirements for new integrations and process enhancements.

Act as liaison between business stakeholders, developers, and QA teams .

Translate business requirements into functional specifications aligned with Workday configuration and integration frameworks.

Review current business processes, identify improvement opportunities, and recommend best practices.

Coordinate and support test planning, execution, and user acceptance testing (UAT) .

Perform functional validation of integrations, execute basic tests, and identify and report defects.

Refine requirements based on technical feedback and test outcomes.

Support project planning activities including estimates, schedules, and documentation in partnership with IT and project managers.


Business Process Expertise (Critical):

Deep understanding of how Workday Business Processes operate end-to-end.

Strong awareness that integration logic is driven by BP design .

Priority Business Processes include:

o Hire

o Termination

o Job Change

o Benefits & Life Events

Full mastery of all Workday BPs is not required — strong knowledge of approximately 25–50 core BPs is sufficient.

Ability to apply BP frameworks consistently across different functional areas.


Integrations (Functional Level):

Understand Workday’s integration framework and architecture .

Ability to open, review, and validate integrations against business requirements.

Execute basic functional integration testing.

Identify simple errors and communicate issues effectively to technical teams.

Write Business Requirements for new integrations .

No development or coding of integrations is expected.


Testing & Quality Assurance:

Partner closely with SDM and QA teams.

Contribute to test strategy, test plans, and test scripts .

Coordinate test cycles and track results through resolution.

Adjust requirements based on validation outcomes.

Support production deployment and post-go-live stabilization.


Stakeholder Interaction:

80% interaction with Senior HR Managers across functional workstreams (Benefits, HR Operations, etc.).

20% interaction with VP-level stakeholders on escalations and high-visibility initiatives.

This role is not heavily political; strong process mastery enables confident stakeholder engagement.

Direct leadership support is available for executive-level presentations when needed.


Immediate Focus (First Months):

Produce Business Requirements for new integrations.

Act as the central connector between business users, developers, and QA.

Refine requirements based on technical feedback.

Coordinate and oversee testing cycles.


Tools & Technical Environment:

Workday (required)

Workday Prism / X10 (nice-to-have, not mandatory)

Flexibility to learn additional tools on the job.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

Strong experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, and process documentation .

Solid understanding of SDLC methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid).

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to interpret data, identify issues, and recommend solutions.

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities.

Ability to act as a key liaison between business operations and IT teams.

Experience working with senior-level business and technology stakeholders.


Education & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business, or related field — or equivalent experience.

5+ years of Workday HCM experience , preferably across Core HR, Benefits, Compensation, Recruiting, Payroll, or Talent modules.

Global Workday implementation experience preferred.

Experience in enterprise-scale or financial services environments is a plus.



Why build your carrer at Meta?

We offer autonomy, clear goals and a dynamic and challenging environment, where professionals have the opportunity to interact with different technologies, participate in all types of projects, bring new ideas and work from anywhere in Brazil and (why not?) anywhere in the world. In addition, we are one of the best companies to work for in Brazil according to Great Place to Work and one of the 10 fastest growing technology companies in the country for 3 consecutive years, according to Anuário Informático Hoje.


What are our values?

- We are people serving people

- We all think and act like owners

- We are hungry for performance

- We grow and learn together

- We pursue excellence and simplicity

- We have innovation and creativity in our DNA

All people are welcome regardless of their condition, disability, ethnicity, religious belief, sexual orientation, appearance, age or others. We want you to grow up with us in a welcoming environment full of opportunities.

Did you relate? Then, #ComeBeMeta!

title: Business Analyst - Workday
description:
Role Summary:

We are seeking a Senior Workday Business Analyst with strong expertise in Workday Business Processes (BPs) and functional integration knowledge . This is a strategic, functional role — not a technical development position — acting as a bridge between HR business teams, IT development, and QA.

The successful candidate will play a central role in translating business needs into clear process and integration requirements, ensuring alignment between Workday Business Processes and downstream integrations, and coordinating testing cycles to deliver high-quality solutions in a global Workday environment.


Key Responsibilities:

Serve as a functional expert in Workday Business Processes , understanding end-to-end process flows.

Write and maintain Business and System Requirements for new integrations and process enhancements.

Act as liaison between business stakeholders, developers, and QA teams .

Translate business requirements into functional specifications aligned with Workday configuration and integration frameworks.

Review current business processes, identify improvement opportunities, and recommend best practices.

Coordinate and support test planning, execution, and user acceptance testing (UAT) .

Perform functional validation of integrations, execute basic tests, and identify and report defects.

Refine requirements based on technical feedback and test outcomes.

Support project planning activities including estimates, schedules, and documentation in partnership with IT and project managers.


Business Process Expertise (Critical):

Deep understanding of how Workday Business Processes operate end-to-end.

Strong awareness that integration logic is driven by BP design .

Priority Business Processes include:

o Hire

o Termination

o Job Change

o Benefits & Life Events

Full mastery of all Workday BPs is not required — strong knowledge of approximately 25–50 core BPs is sufficient.

Ability to apply BP frameworks consistently across different functional areas.


Integrations (Functional Level):

Understand Workday’s integration framework and architecture .

Ability to open, review, and validate integrations against business requirements.

Execute basic functional integration testing.

Identify simple errors and communicate issues effectively to technical teams.

Write Business Requirements for new integrations .

No development or coding of integrations is expected.


Testing & Quality Assurance:

Partner closely with SDM and QA teams.

Contribute to test strategy, test plans, and test scripts .

Coordinate test cycles and track results through resolution.

Adjust requirements based on validation outcomes.

Support production deployment and post-go-live stabilization.


Stakeholder Interaction:

80% interaction with Senior HR Managers across functional workstreams (Benefits, HR Operations, etc.).

20% interaction with VP-level stakeholders on escalations and high-visibility initiatives.

This role is not heavily political; strong process mastery enables confident stakeholder engagement.

Direct leadership support is available for executive-level presentations when needed.


Immediate Focus (First Months):

Produce Business Requirements for new integrations.

Act as the central connector between business users, developers, and QA.

Refine requirements based on technical feedback.

Coordinate and oversee testing cycles.


Tools & Technical Environment:

Workday (required)

Workday Prism / X10 (nice-to-have, not mandatory)

Flexibility to learn additional tools on the job.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

Strong experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, and process documentation .

Solid understanding of SDLC methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid).

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to interpret data, identify issues, and recommend solutions.

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities.

Ability to act as a key liaison between business operations and IT teams.

Experience working with senior-level business and technology stakeholders.


Education & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business, or related field — or equivalent experience.

5+ years of Workday HCM experience , preferably across Core HR, Benefits, Compensation, Recruiting, Payroll, or Talent modules.

Global Workday implementation experience preferred.

Experience in enterprise-scale or financial services environments is a plus.

We offer autonomy, clear goals and a dynamic and challenging environment, where professionals have the opportunity to interact with different technologies, participate in all types of projects, bring new ideas and work from anywhere in Brazil and (why not?) anywhere in the world. - We have innovation and creativity in our DNA

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
A Teddy está em busca de um Engenheiro de Dados apaixonado por transformar informações em insights impactantes. Se você tem experiência com pipelines de dados, garante a qualidade e a consistência, e adora trabalhar com tecnologias como Apache Airflow, Git e AWS, queremos você no nosso time! Junte-se a nós para desenvolver soluções inovadoras em um ambiente colaborativo, usando suas habilidades em SQL, NoSQL, ETL e Python. Se está pronto para esse desafio e deseja impulsionar nossa estratégia de dados, estamos ansiosos para conhecê-lo!

Responsabilidades:

  • Ingestão de Dados no Data Lake: Desenvolver e gerenciar pipelines de dados que permitem a ingestão de grandes volumes de dados em tempo real ou em batch no Data Lake, garantindo a qualidade e a consistência dos dados armazenados.
  • Conhecimento em Bancos de Dados: Forte entendimento de bancos de dados relacionais (SQL) e não relacionais (NoSQL), incluindo modelagem de dados, consultas complexas e otimização de performance.
  • ETL (Extract, Transform, Load): Design e implementação de processos ETL para transformar dados brutos em informações utilizáveis, garantindo que os dados estejam limpos, formatados e prontos para análise.


Ferramentas e Tecnologias:

  • Apache Airflow: Automação de fluxos de trabalho e orquestração de processos de dados para garantir que as tarefas sejam executadas de forma eficiente e em sequência correta.
  • Git: Controle de versão de código, garantindo que todas as alterações em scripts e pipelines de dados sejam registradas e que as colaborações em equipe sejam organizadas e seguras.
  • AWS (Amazon Web Services): Utilização de serviços de cloud computing para armazenamento, processamento e análise de dados, incluindo S3, Redshift, Lambda, e outros serviços relevantes.
  • Programação em Python: Uso avançado de Python para desenvolvimento de scripts de automação, manipulação de dados, integração de APIs, e criação de pipelines de dados complexos. Python é frequentemente utilizado em conjunto com bibliotecas específicas para manipulação de dados, como Pandas, PySpark, entre outras.

Habilidades:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em SQL e NoSQL.
  • Experiência prática com ETL e Data Lakes.
  • Proficiência em Python e bibliotecas relacionadas a dados.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de orquestração e automação de fluxos de trabalho, especialmente Airflow.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com sistemas de controle de versão, como Git.
  • Experiência com serviços de nuvem, particularmente AWS.


Benefícios:

  • VR/VA Flash Benefícios
  • Assistência Médica - Bradesco Saúde
  • Assistência Odontológica - Bradesco
  • Programa de Orientação Pessoal – C4Life
  • Day Off de Aniversário
  • Plano de Carreira
  • Total Pass
  • Seguro de Vida
  • FIAP
  • Alura

title: Vendedor(a) / Closer - Francês Definitivo
description:
Vaga para vendedor(a) - Francês Definitivo

Buscamos pessoas para atuar com vendas nos cursos da empresa Francês Definitivo.


Quem somos

Francês Definitivo é uma empresa brasileira especializada no ensino do francês, criada pela professora Tatiana Rebello, com foco em imersão, autonomia do aluno e acompanhamento ao longo de todo o processo de aprendizagem.

Somos a única empresa no Brasil que oferece cursos de francês 100% em francês, por meio de um método de imersão linguística, desde os níveis iniciais até os avançados. Nosso modelo pedagógico prioriza a exposição contínua ao idioma e a construção real de autonomia.

A empresa é reconhecida pelo alto nível de acompanhamento oferecido aos alunos, considerado um dos mais completos do mercado, refletido na excelente aprovação e na avaliação máxima (5 estrelas) na plataforma Hotmart.

Atuamos com cursos online voltados a diferentes objetivos, como aprendizado geral do francês, francês essencial para viagens, preparação para exames de proficiência visando imigração (TCF e TEF), sempre com um modelo de vendas consultivo, baseado em escuta, orientação clara e acompanhamento pós-venda.

Nossa equipe atua de forma organizada, remota e colaborativa, com processos definidos e responsabilidade no uso de dados e informações dos alunos.


Atuação:

Venda dos cursos da empresa Francês Definitivo. A função envolve conversar com leads e alunos, compreender os objetivos dos alunos, orientar sobre os diversos cursos com clareza e profissionalismo, além de acompanhar o processo de inscrição, pagamento e pós-venda.


Perfil esperado:

  • Experiência com vendas
  • Excelente português oral e escrito
  • Comunicação clara, com capacidade de escuta e orientação
  • Registro consistente das interações com leads em CRM, preferencialmente Pipedrive
  • Organização no acompanhamento dos leads, com responsabilidade na proteção dos dados da empresa
  • Conhecimento e uso de Calendly e Excel
  • Afinidade com educação e estudo, aprendizado de línguas, preferencialmente língua francesa
  • Atuação como PJ
  • Computador próprio e excelente conexão com a internet
  • Trabalho 100% remoto, com a possibilidade de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil, respeitando os horários definidos pela empresa


Modelo:

Período de teste com duas pessoas, com possibilidade de contratação de uma ao final.

description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.


Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.


Nossa cultura:

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


We are looking for an experienced L2 Support Analyst to provide functional production support for enterprise Contract Management Software (CMS/CLM) platforms. This role focuses on incident resolution, configuration support, and close collaboration with business users and technical teams to ensure system stability and efficient contract operations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 2 production support for Contract Management Software platforms, including incident, problem, and service request management.
  • Analyze and resolve issues related to:
  • Contract templates, clause libraries, and fallback logic
  • Workflows, approvals, and business rule configurations
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract type setups
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring functional and configuration-related issues.
  • Support minor enhancements and functional configuration changes (non-code).
  • Troubleshoot integration-related issues and coordinate with Level 3 technical teams when required.
  • Manage user access, role assignments, and permission-related issues.
  • Execute approved data corrections, metadata updates, and configuration fixes.
  • Support UAT and regression testing for fixes and minor platform updates.
  • Maintain support documentation, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate closely with L1 support teams, business stakeholders, and L3 technical teams to ensure timely issue resolution.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience providing production support for Contract Management Software (CLM/CMS) platforms (e.g., Icertis, Coupa CLM, DocuSign CLM, SAP CLM, or similar).
  • Strong hands-on experience with functional configurations, including:
  • Contract templates and clause libraries
  • Workflows, rules, and approvals
  • English (B2- Fluent)
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract types
  • Solid understanding of contract lifecycle management processes .
  • Experience working with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications in complex or regulated environments.
  • Exposure to system integrations with ERP, CRM, or document management platforms.
  • Familiarity with ITIL-based support models or Agile delivery environments.


UST is waiting for you!

title: App Modernization Architect
description:
13+ Years of development and app modernization experience. Experience in hosting and configuring the applications on IIS. Experience in modernization of Applications to Azure PaaS platform along with migration experience. Expertise in application hosting, configuration, optimization in various Azure PaaS services: Azure App service, Azure Functions, Aure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Instance. Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to find alternate ways to reach the goals. Ability to understand application architecture, dependencies, and integrations . Should have led and managed the team with the size more than 5 members. Should be able to guide the team technically. Very good understanding of application migration scenarios and pathways.



  • Primary skills:
  • Hands on web application development skills
  • Hands on experience in developing and hosting web applications on Azure PaaS platform
  • Primary database skills like database connectivity, configurations etc.
  • Ability to analyze application dependencies.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architect, Data Platform, DevOps, and Integration Teams to ensure cloud adoption follows standard best practices.
  • Well versed with containerizing web application frontend and web services.
  • Should know the nitty-gritties of hosting containerized application on Kubernetes
  • Application performance assessment pre and post migration
  • Ensure that the proposed solution covers Azure strategy, stakeholder management as well as the actual solution covering business, application and Infrastructure as well as commercial aspects (in terms of value for money and not commercial costing etc.)
  • Understanding customer Infra landscape. Design Azure Landing Zone and provide the Azure target state solution architecture.




  • Secondary Skills:
  • Work with Internal stakeholders, Customer stakeholders and Project Managers to understand the migration requirements and provide solutions accordingly
  • Troubleshooting experience with Azure PaaS platform
  • Basic understanding of containerization and AKS service




  • Soft Skills:
  • Good customers connect
  • Positive attitude and excellent communication skills to manage customer calls
  • Prepare solution presentations
  • Ability to work well in a team
  • Excellent problem-solving skills
  • Good communication

Confira As Principais Atividades Desta Vaga

  • Liderar a frente de Inteligência Artificial, conectando demandas das áreas de negócio às soluções tecnológicas
  • Coordenar o setup e a evolução da esteira de IA em parceria com consultorias especializadas
  • Definir e garantir os requisitos de arquitetura dos aplicativos e soluções de IA
  • Conduzir o mapeamento, análise e priorização de casos de uso junto às áreas internas
  • Gerenciar a atuação de fornecedores e consultorias, assegurando entregas dentro dos padrões técnicos e estratégicos da companhia
  • Articular o suporte e a atuação do time interno de dados nas iniciativas de IA


Requisitos e qualificações

Curtiu?! Vamos em frente, entenda o que esperamos de você:

  • Ensino superior completo
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos técnicos de Inteligência Artificial
  • Visão sólida de arquitetura de soluções
  • Experiência em gestão de fornecedores e consultorias
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis
  • Boa organização e comunicação interpessoal
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas e conceitos de Inteligência Artificial

title: Software Engineer Pleno .NET
description:

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

title: Client Account Manager (CAM) - Trading
description:
About This Critical Role:


Are you passionate about financial markets and client success? We're looking for a dedicated Client Account Manager to serve as the guardian of our clients' trading operations. This hands-on position puts you at the center of daily trading activities, ensuring our algorithmic systems perform flawlessly for every client.



Your Daily Impact:


- Market Open Preparation (Pre-9:30 AM EST):

- Execute morning startup procedures across all client VPS environments

- Verify trading account connectivity and algorithm activation

- Document market conditions and system status in real-time tracking sheets

- Ensure clients are positioned for optimal trading from market open



Active Market Monitoring:


- Conduct hourly wellness checks on all client accounts

- Proactively identify and resolve connectivity or performance issues

- Maintain constant vigilance over algorithmic trading performance

- Provide immediate troubleshooting and escalation when needed



End-of-Day Excellence:


- Execute proper market close procedures for all accounts

- Generate personalized daily performance reports for each client

- Deliver professional updates via Discord summarizing trading results

- Prepare systems for the next trading session



Location:


We are specifically seeking candidates based in Colombia, Argentina, Costa Rica, Brazil, and Mexico . If you're located in Latin America and have availability during U.S. market hours, we encourage you to apply.


If you have daytrading experience , even better - it's not required, but it will give you a significant advantage in this role.



Ideal Candidate Profile:


Core Requirements:


- Professional-grade internet connection and reliable computer setup

- Availability during U.S. market hours (9:30 AM – 4:00 PM EST)

- Exceptional attention to detail with zero-tolerance for errors

- Strong written communication skills for client reporting

- Ability to work independently while maintaining high standards



Valuable Assets:


- Experience with VPS environments or remote desktop management

- Knowledge of NinjaTrader or similar trading platforms

- Background in financial markets or trading operations

- Previous client-facing or account management experience



What We Offer:


- Market-Hours Focus: Work during active trading hours with evenings free

- Client Impact: Directly contribute to client success and satisfaction

- Professional Development: Gain deep experience in algorithmic trading operations

- Comprehensive Support: Complete training program with ongoing mentorship

- Competitive Package: $2,500/month with performance-based growth opportunities

- Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere with reliable internet



Ready to Make an Impact?


If you're detail-oriented, technically capable, and excited about playing a crucial role in our clients' trading success, we want to hear from you. Join our team and help shape the future of algorithmic trading at Vincere Trading.


Please make a 5 minute loom video going over your trading and Client Account Management experience and why you would be a good fit for this role, and email it to: Thank you!

title: Crypto Venture Analyst
description:
Crypto Venture Analyst

Company: Meta Martian

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Department: Investment & Research

Compensation Strategy

Salary Range: $70,000 – $100,000 USD / year We pay in USD or USDC. This compensation package is explicitly benchmarked to the top 1% of the Brazilian venture capital market. We believe in rewarding high-conviction insights, not just hours worked.

The Investment Mandate and Regional Focus

Meta Martian is deploying capital into the builders who are re-architecting the internet. We are seeking a Crypto Venture Analyst based in Brazil to act as our eyes and ears in the LATAM market-one of the fastest-growing crypto adoption zones in the world. Your mandate is to identify high-signal opportunities before they hit the mainstream radar. You are not here to follow the herd; you are here to build the thesis that the herd will eventually follow. You will be dissecting early-stage protocols, connecting with founders in São Paulo, Rio, and Buenos Aires, and feeding high-quality deal flow into our global investment committee.

Due Diligence and Deal Flow Mechanics

This role is the engine of our decision-making process. You will lead the rigorous \"under the hood\" inspection of potential investments. This goes far beyond reading a pitch deck. We expect you to scrutinize the technical architecture, challenge the founders on their go-to-market assumptions, and verify the integrity of their team. You will manage the entire deal funnel: from the first coffee meeting with a founder to writing the final Investment Memo that convinces our partners to sign a check. You must be comfortable asking uncomfortable questions to protect our capital.

Thesis Generation and Tokenomics Forensics

We do not invest in \"vibes.\" We invest in sustainable mechanics. A core part of your role is Tokenomic Stress-Testing . You will take a project's proposed token distribution and model it out over 5 years. You must answer critical questions: Does the token capture value? Is the inflation schedule predatory? Is the FDV (Fully Diluted Valuation) realistic compared to competitors? You will produce deep-dive sector research-whether on DePIN, Zero-Knowledge proofs, or RWA-that shapes our firm's view on where the market is heading over the next cycle.

What We Are Not Looking For (The Anti-Persona)

To respect your time, let us define what this role is not :

  • Not a \"Spray and Pray\" Investor: We are a high-conviction fund. If you like throwing small checks at every meme coin, this is not for you.
  • Not a Passive Observer: If you wait for deals to come to your inbox, you will fail. We need a hunter who is active in the developer trenches.
  • Not a Chart Watcher: This is a Venture Capital role (Seed/Series A), not a liquid hedge fund role. We do not care about daily price action; we care about multi-year technology horizons.
The Analyst Archetype
  • You are deeply embedded in the crypto culture. You likely have a \"degen\" past but a professional present. You are fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus). You have a network of developers and builders in Brazil who trust you. You are intellectually honest-you are willing to kill your own favorite deal if the data shows it is a bad investment. You combine the networking skills of a BD manager with the analytical rigor of a mathematician.

Responsabilidades Principais


Desenhar a arquitetura técnica dos agentes, incluindo fluxos de orquestração, memória, integrações e camadas de decisão.


Garantir o correto funcionamento lógico dos agentes, desde a concepção até a execução em produção.


Aplicar arquiteturas de agentes baseadas em MCP (Model Context Protocol), garantindo modularidade e padronização ou A2A.


Implementar, evoluir e refatorar componentes técnicos de IA de forma contínua.



Atuação Técnica (Hands-on)


Desenvolver soluções em Python, atuando diretamente no código dos agentes.


Construir e manter fluxos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph para orquestração e controle de estados.


Implementar e gerenciar bancos de dados vetorizados para busca semântica, memória e recuperação de contexto.


Atuar em integrações, testes, validações técnicas e troubleshooting.



Integração com SAP e Times Técnicos


Trabalhar de forma integrada com a equipe técnica de SAP para viabilizar os agentes de IA.


Entender os fluxos, dados e restrições do ecossistema SAP.


Desenhar soluções de agentes alinhadas aos processos SAP, garantindo viabilidade técnica e aderência ao contexto do cliente.


Atuar como ponte técnica entre IA e SAP, assegurando integração consistente e sustentável.



Qualidade, Padrões e Governança


Definir padrões técnicos, boas práticas e guidelines para desenvolvimento de agentes de IA.


Garantir qualidade, segurança, performance e observabilidade das soluções.


Assegurar que a arquitetura seja escalável, reutilizável e preparada para evolução.

  • Experiência prévia com liderança técnica.
  • Python para desenvolvimento e manutenção de agentes de IA.

title: Microsoft Dynamics Developer
description:
About You

You are a technically strong Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Developer who enjoys building, customizing, and integrating enterprise-grade ERP solutions. You thrive in structured environments, value best practices, and take ownership of delivering reliable, well-documented systems. You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and feel comfortable supporting, maintaining, and evolving complex business applications.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations Apps Developer Associate (mandatory and up to date, with annual renewal).
  • Strong experience developing and customizing Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) solutions.
  • Solid understanding of D365 F&O architecture, development lifecycle, and best practices.
  • Proven experience designing and maintaining integrations using Azure Data Factory for ETL and data synchronization.
  • Hands-on experience using Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS) for deployment, monitoring, environment management, and maintenance.
  • Ability to collaborate with functional and technical stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills for production and non-production environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Develop, customize, and maintain Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations applications based on business requirements.
  • Design, build, and support data integrations using Azure Data Factory, ensuring data accuracy and reliability.
  • Use Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS) to manage deployments, monitor environments, and support application health.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (functional consultants, developers, business users) to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards and best practices.
  • Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for D365 F&O applications.
  • Document technical designs, configurations, integrations, and operational processes.
  • Support ongoing maintenance, optimization, and continuous improvement of D365 F&O solutions.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: SAP S/4HANA Business Systems Analyst – (E-invoice)
description:
We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Business Systems Analyst to expand our E-invoice integrations offering.


Job responsibilities/ Role Requirements include:

• Provide subject matter expertise on tax determination, reporting and compliance (including e-invoicing)

• Perform detailed analysis, feasibility, and integration design of business processes within SAP S/4HANA modules (MM, SD, and FI) to the integration

• Assist in project management, implementation planning and test approach / planning

• Solid understanding of tax data flow between organizational systems, technical architecture, integrations, and data pipelines between ERP and Tax/ compliance systems.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross functionally with other Functional Consultants, Developers/ Architects, Sales, Professional Services, Customer Support, Tax Research, Customers and Prospects

• Prepare detailed Functional Specification documentation with use cases, PowerPoint presentations, and other documents to explain requirements internally and externally.

• Support the product development process, working closely with Development, QA and Documentation teams throughout the whole product life cycle, feature validating functionality, as well as preparing the rest of the organization for product release.

• Assist with end-user documentation, process flows, specifications, and diagrams to provide direction to customers, partners and professional services, and support teams.

• Support product rollouts and implementations as domain expert and/or primary business interface to other parties.

• Follow product into the field to ensure customer success, providing business and data integration expertise to customers, partners and internal professional services personnel as needed.

• Assist in providing 2nd level support and training to Customer Support, Professional Services, and integration partners.

• Provide business expertise in sales calls as needed.


Qualifications

• Working experience in SAP localization requirements

• Working experience in Indirect Tax Compliance and E- Invoicing

• Experience in SAP S/4HANA configuration and implementation (FI, SD or MM) and Strong knowledge in various SAP business processes in FI, SD and MM and cross module integrations.

title: LLM – Business Analyst
description:
Job Description: LLM – Business Analyst

Role Type: Short-Term Contract (2 months)

Location: Remote – Colombia


Commitment: Full-time (40 hours/week, 8 hours/day) with 4–5 hours overlap with PST


About the Role

We are seeking detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning . This role is ideal for professionals with strong analytical skills, familiarity with digital tools, and experience in evaluation or QA-type work.

Responsibilities

  • Perform side-by-side evaluations, comparing outputs for quality and accuracy.
  • Conduct fact-checking and identify inconsistencies.
  • Provide clear justifications for evaluation decisions.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions for analysis.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required.
  • Document findings and communicate insights.

Requirements

  • Strong computer skills in a professional setting.
  • Experience with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Analytical and critical thinking skills with high attention to detail.
  • Good written communication skills in English.
  • Must be based in Argentina, Mexico, Peru, Brazil, Chile, or Colombia .

Nice to Have

  • Experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.

title: Crypto Market Maker
description:
Crypto Market Maker Company: Meta Martian Location: Brazil (Remote) Department: Algorithmic Trading and Liquidity

Compensation Strategy

Salary Range: $100,000 – $140,000 USD per year plus Performance Bonus We pay in USD or USDC. This base salary is benchmarked significantly above the local Brazilian market rate for quantitative finance roles. We expect world-class execution and we pay accordingly.

The Mission and Market Function

At Meta Martian , we provide the liquidity that keeps the crypto economy moving. We are seeking a Crypto Market Maker to manage our proprietary trading strategies on both Centralized (CEX) and Decentralized (DEX) exchanges. Your mission is not to predict the future price of Bitcoin. Your mission is to ensure that our order books are deep, our spreads are tight, and our inventory is balanced. You are the architect of market efficiency.

The Scope of Execution

Your primary mandate is the management of our automated trading systems. You will oversee a portfolio of market-making algorithms that quote bid and ask orders 24 hours a day. You must constantly adjust the parameters of these bots based on market volatility. When the market is calm, you capture the spread. When the market crashes, you manage the risk to ensure we do not end up holding \"toxic flow.\" You are responsible for the daily Profit and Loss (PnL) of your assigned pairs.

Operational Responsibility and Tooling

This role requires a hybrid of trading intuition and engineering skill. You will spend your day in Python . You will write scripts to analyze trade history and optimize our quoting logic. You will connect to Exchange APIs via WebSocket to monitor latency and order rejection rates. You will work closely with our quant developers to improve our execution infrastructure, but you must be capable of fixing a broken script yourself in the middle of the night if necessary.

Negative Scope

To ensure we are aligned, please note the following:

  • Not a Discretionary Trader: You will not be manually buying or selling assets based on technical analysis patterns or news sentiment. You manage systems, not individual trades.
  • Not a Blockchain Developer: You do not need to write Smart Contracts in Solidity. You need to understand market microstructure and exchange connectivity.
  • Not an Entry-Level Role: We cannot train you on the basics of an Order Book or how an AMM works. You must arrive with this knowledge fully formed.
The Trader Archetype

We are looking for a candidate with a background in Mathematics, Physics, or Computer Science . You have professional experience in high-frequency trading (HFT) or electronic market making, either in crypto or traditional finance (B3/BM&F). You are comfortable handling large notional values and stay calm when volatility spikes. You understand that in market making, risk management is more important than profit maximization.

title: Engenheiro de dados - Líder Técnico
description:
A VMBears é uma empresa jovem e moderna com o objetivo de ajudar seus clientes a aproveitar novas tecnologias para acelerar seus negócios. Fornece serviços de consultoria para arquitetura corporativa e modernização de sistemas para nuvem. Fundada em 2018, possui em seu DNA a ética, a positividade, o comprometimento e a inovação. Somos focados em oferecer os melhores serviços prestados através dos melhores profissionais do mercado. Esses recursos são utilizados para auxiliar os clientes em sua jornada de modernização tecnológica e transformação digital.


O que buscamos?

O Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o profissional que constrói e mantém a infraestrutura responsável por mover, transformar e disponibilizar dados com confiabilidade e performance. Um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados eficaz domina pipelines batch + streaming, otimiza consultas em data-warehouses colunares e garante a rastreabilidade ponta-a-ponta de cada registro. Na prática, atua como elo entre arquitetura e desenvolvimento, permanecendo intrinsecamente ligado(a) ao código que sustenta o fluxo de informações.


Na VMBears, o Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o(a) guardião(ã) da qualidade dos dados: projeta pipelines escaláveis, monitora sua saúde em produção e antecipa gargalos. Para este projeto, a modernização de um motor de cálculo de alto volume no setor de energia, buscamos alguém que una profundidade técnica em processamento distribuído e lakehouse a uma mentalidade de produto baseada em dados.


Você integrará o squad que modernizará o Motor de Cálculo, um engine que processa bilhões de registros, aplica centenas de fórmulas regulatórias e gera resultados contábeis que movem o mercado de energia elétrica. Procuramos alguém que combine habilidade de modelar dados massivos com espírito de colaboração, ajudando o time a migrar de um monolito PL/SQL para uma plataforma distribuída, event-driven e cloud-native, onde cada byte chegue rápido, íntegro e auditável ao novo motor.


Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar soluções com arquitetura de dados distribuída, garantindo latência e throughput que atendam aos requisitos da do negócio;
  • Implantar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e publicação que suportem batch + streaming em larga escala;
  • Desenvolver jobs Spark/Flink e para data-warehouses colunares;
  • Seguir padrões de versionamento, catalogação e lineage de dados para rastreabilidade de processamento;
  • Desenvolver processos sempre visando o menor custo e maior performance em Redshift/BigQuery/Athena, propondo ajustes de partição, compressão e caching;
  • Documentar processos e fluxos de trabalho de dados: Manter registros detalhados dos processos de dados para facilitar a manutenção e a melhoria contínua;
  • Projetar sistemas que possam crescer conforme a demanda por dados aumenta.


Stack desejável:

  • Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake, Athena, Iceberg, Delta Lake;
  • Spark (DataFrames, Structured Streaming), Flink, EMR, Dataproc, Databricks, Hadoop (YARN, HDFS);
  • Apache NiFi, Kafka Connect, AWS DMS, Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub;
  • Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, OpenTelemetry, DataHub, Great Expectations;
  • Terraform/IaC, CI/CD Git, testes de dados automatizados, segurança LGPD (IAM fine-grained, encryption at rest/in transit).


Requisitos imprescindíveis:

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro de Dados: Ter um histórico sólido na área de engenharia de dados. Pensamento lógico e solução de problemas complexos.
  • Proficiência em alguma linguagem de programação (Python, Java e outras) e SQL: Ser capaz de usar essas linguagens de programação para manipular e gerenciar dados.
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de big data: Familiaridade com ferramentas que permitem o processamento de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência com sistemas de gerenciamento de banco de dados: Saber como projetar e manter bancos de dados eficientes. Organização para gerenciar grandes volumes de dados e processos críticos.
  • Habilidades de resolução de problemas e pensamento analítico: Capacidade de identificar e resolver problemas complexos de dados. Habilidade de documentação e boas práticas em arquitetura de dados.


Segue abaixo os benefícios oferecidos:

  • Auxílio home-office;
  • Nossa forma de trabalho é totalmente home-office permitindo que você esteja sempre perto de quem mais importa;
  • Descontos em academias através do Total Pass;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional aqui é primordial, por isso oferecemos um programa de capacitação online onde você recebe R$300,00 de crédito semestralmente para adquirir cursos na plataforma Udemy;
  • Quer se certificar em algum skill que se faz necessário para sua atuação profissional? Reembolsamos suas certificações!
  • Gosta de trabalhar aqui? Então indique um amigo ou parente! Nosso programa de indicação de novos Bears oferece R$2.000,00 por pessoa que permaneça conosco por mais de 3 meses.

O Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o profissional que constrói e mantém a infraestrutura responsável por mover, transformar e disponibilizar dados com confiabilidade e performance. Um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados eficaz domina pipelines batch + streaming, otimiza consultas em data-warehouses colunares e garante a rastreabilidade ponta-a-ponta de cada registro. Na prática, atua como elo entre arquitetura e desenvolvimento, permanecendo intrinsecamente ligado(a) ao código que sustenta o fluxo de informações.


Na VMBears, o Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o(a) guardião(ã) da qualidade dos dados: projeta pipelines escaláveis, monitora sua saúde em produção e antecipa gargalos. Para este projeto, a modernização de um motor de cálculo de alto volume no setor de energia, buscamos alguém que una profundidade técnica em processamento distribuído e lakehouse a uma mentalidade de produto baseada em dados.


Você integrará o squad que modernizará o Motor de Cálculo, um engine que processa bilhões de registros, aplica centenas de fórmulas regulatórias e gera resultados contábeis que movem o mercado de energia elétrica. Procuramos alguém que combine habilidade de modelar dados massivos com espírito de colaboração, ajudando o time a migrar de um monolito PL/SQL para uma plataforma distribuída, event-driven e cloud-native, onde cada byte chegue rápido, íntegro e auditável ao novo motor.


Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar soluções com arquitetura de dados distribuída, garantindo latência e throughput que atendam aos requisitos da do negócio;
  • Implantar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e publicação que suportem batch + streaming em larga escala;
  • Desenvolver jobs Spark/Flink e para data-warehouses colunares;
  • Seguir padrões de versionamento, catalogação e lineage de dados para rastreabilidade de processamento;
  • Desenvolver processos sempre visando o menor custo e maior performance em Redshift/BigQuery/Athena, propondo ajustes de partição, compressão e caching;
  • Documentar processos e fluxos de trabalho de dados: Manter registros detalhados dos processos de dados para facilitar a manutenção e a melhoria contínua;
  • Projetar sistemas que possam crescer conforme a demanda por dados aumenta.


Stack desejável:

  • Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake, Athena, Iceberg, Delta Lake;
  • Spark (DataFrames, Structured Streaming), Flink, EMR, Dataproc, Databricks, Hadoop (YARN, HDFS);
  • Apache NiFi, Kafka Connect, AWS DMS, Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub;
  • Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, OpenTelemetry, DataHub, Great Expectations;
  • Terraform/IaC, CI/CD Git, testes de dados automatizados, segurança LGPD (IAM fine-grained, encryption at rest/in transit).


Requisitos imprescindíveis:

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro de Dados: Ter um histórico sólido na área de engenharia de dados. Pensamento lógico e solução de problemas complexos.
  • Proficiência em alguma linguagem de programação (Python, Java e outras) e SQL: Ser capaz de usar essas linguagens de programação para manipular e gerenciar dados.
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de big data: Familiaridade com ferramentas que permitem o processamento de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência com sistemas de gerenciamento de banco de dados: Saber como projetar e manter bancos de dados eficientes. Organização para gerenciar grandes volumes de dados e processos críticos.
  • Habilidades de resolução de problemas e pensamento analítico: Capacidade de identificar e resolver problemas complexos de dados. Habilidade de documentação e boas práticas em arquitetura de dados.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company that provides technical expertise, testing, and certification services to the global food and agricultural industry. Their mission is to ensure food safety, quality, and sustainability across international supply chains.


They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering their flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure the software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.


This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be asked to perform additional tasks as required, that may or may not be related to their primary duties.


Required Qualifications:


  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.


This is a CRT Role at R$18,000/month + Annual Bonus
