title: Physical Therapist
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Physical Therapist to join our team.


If you have a passion for improving lives through exercise, certifications in sports medicine or orthopedic expertise, we want to hear from you. Our ideal candidate has a minimum of 3 years of experience, along with additional certifications, and is proficient in advanced English.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunity for career advancement and professional growth.
  • Full-time position with the flexibility to work from a home office.
  • Engaging work environment with deep human interaction, focused on patient care.
  • Chance to make a significant impact on patients' health and well-being.


Salary:

  • After a paid initial 4 month intensive education and on-boarding process which is paid at 1st month 1st month: R$3,100, 2nd month: R$4,650, 3rd month: R$6,200, 4th month: R$7,750. After one year, there will be an opportunity to increase your income beyond R$9,300, with most team members eventually earning over R$7,750 per month.
  • After your first year with us you will have additional benefits of 2 weeks paid vacation, health insurance, and retirement funds.


Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience.
  • Advanced English proficiency for clear communication.
  • Ability to effectively convey exercise techniques.
  • Sports medicine or Orthopedic expertise to address specific needs and limitations.
  • Additional certifications showcasing your commitment to professional growth.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Outgoing personality to motivate and engage patients.
  • Continuous training mindset to stay updated with industry advancements.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage patient progress and programs.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and provide feedback on personalized exercise programs for patients.
  • Utilize your teaching background to educate and empower patients.
  • Leverage orthopedic expertise to design safe and effective exercise routines.
  • Provide ongoing guidance and support for patients' fitness journeys.
  • Maintain open and effective communication with patients.


Join our team and be part of a dynamic environment where continuous training and deep human interaction are valued.


Employment Type

Full-time

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend (IA)
description:
Ser referência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de funcionalidades de software , de modo que não apenas agregue valor ao produto como também oriente e capacite o time de desenvolvimento, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a evolução técnica do time de desenvolvimento do produto de atuação. Especialidade em Backend.

Conhecimentos Específicos Desejáveis:

- Lógica de Programação;

- Arquitetura de Software (cloudnative, web, microserviços);

- APIs REST;

- Banco de Dados SQL Relacionais (PostgreSQL, equivalentes);

- Testes Automatizados (JUnit, Jest, Karma ou equivalentes);

- DevOps (CI/CD, Docker, Git/GitFlow, GitLab, Jenkins ou similar);

- Feature Flags e estratégias de deploy;

- Sistemas Distribuídos, Escalabilidade, Resiliência (nível intermediário);

- Mensageria (RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub ou equivalente);

- NoSQL (Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalente);

- Cache (Redis);

- Infraestrutura como código (Terraform)(opcional)

- Orquestração de containers (Kubernetes)(opcional)

- Cloud Storage (Google Cloud Storage ou equivalente)

- Processamento distribuído (Hadoop, Spark)

- Pipelines de dados/streaming (Apache Beam, Dataflow, Airflow)

- Processamento assíncrono (Celery, Temporal IO)

- MCP (opcional)

- Copilot ou equivalente (opcional)

- Provedores de Cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure, equivalentes)

- Design Patterns

- Segurança no desenvolvimento (DevSecOps, outros)

- APIFirts e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (CleanCode, etc...)

- Observabilidade e troubleshooting de aplicações em produção (logs estruturados, métricas, traces)

- Metodologia Ágil

- Java avançado

- Spring / Spring Boot / Spring Cloud

- Hibernate ou equivalente ORM

- Experiência em integrações complexas (REST APIs externas)

Certificações: Relacionadas a área como por exemplo Java, Spring, Python, Front-end ou Cloud Provider.

title: Mobile Software Engineer - React Native (Mid/Senior)
description:
eNor Securities is a fintech focused on financial infrastructure, digital assets, and regulated products , operating at the intersection of traditional finance and the crypto ecosystem.

We work in a highly complex technical and regulatory environment , building products that require robustness, security, scalability, and clear architecture .

Our engineering team works closely with product and business, making technical decisions with real impact on operations and company growth.

About the role

We are looking for a Mobile Software Engineer with a strong focus on React Native to strategically contribute to the evolution of our mobile applications.

Beyond building screens, we seek someone with strong engineering fundamentals , mobile architectural thinking , and the ability to collaborate closely with backend, product, and design.

You will help build scalable, stable, and high-quality mobile applications , designed to support critical financial products and long-term evolution.

Expected profile
  • Mid to Senior level
  • 5+ years of experience in mobile or frontend development
  • Strong understanding of mobile architecture and state management
  • Comfortable discussing technical trade-offs and proposing solutions
  • Hands-on , collaborative, quality-oriented mindset
  • Technical English required for reading, writing, and professional communication
Required skills
  • Solid experience with React Native
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript
  • Experience with modern mobile architectures and component-based design
  • Familiarity with REST and/or GraphQL APIs
  • Ability to write testable, performant, and maintainable mobile code
  • Understanding of the mobile lifecycle (Android and iOS)
Nice to have
  • State management (Redux, Zustand, MobX, or similar)
  • Modern React / React Native patterns (Hooks, Context, performance optimizations)
  • Mobile testing (Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox, or similar)
  • App publishing and maintenance on App Store and Google Play
  • Native API integrations (native modules, bridges)
  • Mobile CI/CD
  • Familiarity with Expo (and clarity on when to use or not)
Responsibilities
  • Contribute to the architectural evolution of mobile applications
  • Implement features aligned with product and design
  • Propose improvements in performance, stability, and user experience
  • Ensure scalable, testable, and sustainable mobile code
  • Work closely with backend, product, and design teams
  • Support continuous improvement of mobile practices and standards
Differentials
  • Experience in fintech, crypto, or financial products
  • Background in large-scale or complex mobile applications
  • Knowledge of mobile performance, UX, and security best practices
  • Senior engineer mindset with a systemic and product-oriented view

If you enjoy real technical challenges and want to build impactful financial infrastructure, come join eNor Securities.

title: SAP BTP
description:
SAP BTP Consultant – Large-Scale International Program

We are supporting a large-scale, international transformation program and are looking for an experienced SAP BTP Consultant to join the team on a long-term engagement . This role offers the opportunity to work in a complex enterprise environment, contributing both strategically and hands-on to a modern SAP landscape.

Project Overview

  • Start: ASAP
  • Duration: 12 months + extension
  • Location: Remote, with occasional travel to Switzerland and Lisbon

Required Technical Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP BTP in enterprise environments

Deep knowledge of:

  • SAP Integration Suite (CPI, APIs, Event Mesh)
  • SAP Extension Suite (CAP, Fiori, side-by-side extensions)
  • SAP BTP security and identity services
  • Proven experience supporting SAP S/4HANA landscapes
  • Cloud-native mindset , including:
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • DevOps practices
  • Scalable and resilient architectures

Professional Profile

  • Proven experience working in complex, multi-brand, global organizations
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills , able to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to influence architecture decisions without direct authority
  • Comfortable operating at both:
  • Strategic level (design, decision-making, alignment)
  • Hands-on level (implementation, troubleshooting, delivery)

⭐ Nice to Have

  • Experience in large transformation or rollout programs
  • Exposure to hybrid or multi-cloud SAP landscapes
  • Consulting or system integrator background

title: Technical Support Consultant L3
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Technical Support Consultant with 3 to 5 years of software support experience to join the client operations team of our U.S. client. You will play a critical role in ensuring our client's software lives up to its world-class reputation.

Our client provides a cloud-based, ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers delivering market-leading field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land software solutions. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Deliver Level 3 customer support for our client's industry-leading software products
  • Triage reported, end-user customer incidents
  • Work technical issues and support the direct client feedback loop process
  • Help secure existing revenue by means of customer retention
  • Provide incident queue management
  • Utilize troubleshooting skills
  • Help manage complex issues and drive escalations to resolution
  • Build and demonstrate cross-application knowledge among the client's core application modules
  • Push the client's software to the limit, making sure it is efficient, intuitive, and best-in-class
  • Gain experience in the oil and gas industry; including economic, accounting, and finance knowledge


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • 3 to 5 years of Level 3 software support experience
  • Basic to intermediate SQL skills
  • Proficiency in using Microsoft Office Suite
  • A drive to continue learning in the energy business and the client's software
  • Advanced problem-solving skills
  • Ability to triage and actively manage a support queue
  • Innate passion for customer service
  • Dependability and ability to manage as well as prioritize concurrent tasks
  • Must be available for an on-call rotation
  • Ability to work U.S. CST business hours
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Experience creating manuals, training documentation, and interactive training materials for software applications
  • Experience providing software support and troubleshooting for SaaS applications
  • Experience in reproducing issues in a test environment prior to production deployment
  • Experience in the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Gerente Soluções SAP
description:
A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Gerente Soluções – SAP


Local: Híbrido 2 vezes por semana em São Paulo (Capital).

Horário: 09:00 – 18:00.


Buscamos Gerente Soluções SAP Sênior, para integrar nosso time de pré-vendas. O profissional atuará em apoio direto à área comercial, definindo estratégias técnicas, coordenando entregas e garantindo propostas competitivas e aderentes às necessidades dos clientes.


Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a equipe de vendas para identificar oportunidades e desenvolver estratégias SAP para os clientes;
  • Realizar apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de produtos para clientes potenciais, destacando benefícios e funcionalidades das soluções SAP;
  • Avaliar e compreender os requisitos SAP dos clientes e oferecer recomendações de soluções adequadas;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de engenharia e desenvolvimento para garantir que as soluções oferecidas atendam às necessidades dos clientes;
  • Elaborar custeio e precificação de soluções SAP, garantindo competitividade e adequação ao mercado;
  • Compreender e gerenciar o ciclo de venda, desde a identificação de oportunidades até o fechamento de contratos;
  • Desenvolver propostas técnicas e comerciais para empresas públicas e privadas, garantindo o cumprimento dos requisitos regulatórios e das especificações do cliente;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de propostas técnicas e documentos de resposta a RFPs/RFIs;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e tecnologias em SAP e disseminar conhecimento na equipe.


Requisitos:

title: Mendix Developer Senior | LowCode
description:
Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto


Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior – Mendix para liderar projetos estratégicos e ser referência técnica no time. Se você tem carreira sólida em tecnologia, experiência mínima de 2 anos com Mendix e gosta de compartilhar conhecimento, essa oportunidade é para você!


O que você vai fazer

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações Mendix, garantindo qualidade e integração.
  • Apoiar decisões de arquitetura e orientar o time em melhores práticas.
  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento, com foco em performance e escalabilidade.
  • Ser referência técnica, promovendo aprendizado e evolução contínua.


Requisitos

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos com Mendix .
  • Conhecimento em integração via APIs , modelagem de dados e versionamento (Git).
  • Experiência com Mendix Studio Pro , Developer Portal e práticas low-code.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Perfil colaborativo e capacidade de orientar equipes.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com arquitetura escalável , microsserviços e mensageria.
  • Conhecimento em Docker/Kubernetes , práticas DevOps e pipelines CI/CD.
  • Vivência com cloud (AWS, Azure) e integração com serviços externos.
  • Base sólida em Java, JavaScript e princípios S.O.L.I.D.



O que oferecemos:


Você fará parte de equipes diversas e de alto performance, em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo. Valorizamos a contribuição de todos na criação de soluções e nas decisões estratégicas. Aqui, as pessoas são o nosso diferencial, e somos apaixonados por tecnologia, inovação e evolução contínua.

title: DevOps Engineer with AWS - Relocation from Brasil to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Technical or Bachelor’s Degree in IT-related areas (at least level 5 or 6);
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in IT areas (Infrastructure, Software Development, Systems Administration);
  • At least 3 years of professional experience working as a DevOps Engineer (mandatory);
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience working with AWS cloud environment (e.g. EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, CloudWatch, EKS/ECS, and Lambda);
  • Experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar;
  • Experience with CI/CD and Automation such as Jenkins, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet (valued);
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Professional experience with programming and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Java, Bash, Shell, or similar);
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools;
  • English proficiency (at least B2 in conversation – mandatory);
  • Availability for relocation from Brasil to Portugal (mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid (2-3 times in the office) or remote, based in Lisbon or Porto cities .


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and apply for this opportunity.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Desenvolvedor ServiceNow
description:
Desenvolvedor (a) Service Now

Atuação Remota

Contratação CLT

O Especialista em ServiceNow será responsável por gerenciar todas as atividades relacionadas à melhoria contínua da plataforma ServiceNow, atuando tanto na administração diária quanto na implementação de pequenas melhorias e desenvolvimentos. Este profissional deve ter um conhecimento amplo do software, abrangendo seus principais módulos e funcionalidades, além de experiência em UX para melhorar a experiência dos usuários finais. Também será capaz de evangelizar o uso da plataforma na organização, promovendo as melhores práticas e o engajamento dos usuários.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar e liderar as melhorias contínuas da plataforma ServiceNow, garantindo a maximização de seu uso.
  • Desenvolver pequenas melhorias e personalizações na plataforma, de acordo com as necessidades do negócio e conforme as boas práticas recomendadas.
  • Atuar como ponto focal para a administração diária do ServiceNow, incluindo a resolução de incidentes, requisições de serviço e suporte ao usuário.
  • Realizar análise de processos para identificar oportunidades de automação e otimização dentro da ferramenta.
  • Promover a adoção dos módulos contratados da plataforma, realizando a gestão de stakeholders e o suporte aos usuários.
  • Fornecer orientações sobre o uso adequado do ServiceNow, definindo padrões, processos e promovendo a cultura de uso da plataforma.
  • Desenvolver e implementar soluções com foco na experiência do usuário (UX), garantindo que as interfaces sejam intuitivas, eficientes e acessíveis.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com as equipes de TI e de negócios para entender e traduzir as necessidades e requisitos para soluções dentro do ServiceNow.
  • Atuar na manutenção de dashboards, relatórios e na melhoria contínua da experiência dos usuários finais.
  • Participar ativamente em projetos de melhoria e novas implementações da plataforma, assegurando a entrega de soluções eficazes e eficientes.


Requisitos Técnicos e de Experiência:

  • Experiência comprovada com a administração e desenvolvimento de melhorias na plataforma ServiceNow.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado dos principais módulos do ServiceNow (ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, CSM, HR Service Delivery, etc.).
  • Habilidade em desenvolver pequenas personalizações, scripts e integrações dentro do ServiceNow.
  • Experiência com a definição e implementação de processos ITIL e boas práticas dentro da plataforma.
  • Experiência em design centrado no usuário (UX/UI) e na criação de interfaces de usuário intuitivas e eficientes no ServiceNow.
  • Capacidade de analisar processos de negócios e traduzi-los em fluxos de trabalho eficientes no ServiceNow.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis (como Scrum ou Kanban) é um diferencial.
  • Certificações ServiceNow (como Certified System Administrator, Certified Implementation Specialist) são desejáveis.

  • Atuar como ponto focal para a administração diária do ServiceNow, incluindo a resolução de incidentes, requisições de serviço e suporte ao usuário.
  • Realizar análise de processos para identificar oportunidades de automação e otimização dentro da ferramenta.
  • Promover a adoção dos módulos contratados da plataforma, realizando a gestão de stakeholders e o suporte aos usuários.
  • Fornecer orientações sobre o uso adequado do ServiceNow, definindo padrões, processos e promovendo a cultura de uso da plataforma.

  • Conhecimento aprofundado dos principais módulos do ServiceNow (ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, CSM, HR Service Delivery, etc.).
  • Habilidade em desenvolver pequenas personalizações, scripts e integrações dentro do ServiceNow.
  • Experiência com a definição e implementação de processos ITIL e boas práticas dentro da plataforma.

  • Capacidade de analisar processos de negócios e traduzi-los em fluxos de trabalho eficientes no ServiceNow.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis (como Scrum ou Kanban) é um diferencial.

title: Visual Effects Artist
description:
Who we are:


Apex Systems is a leading professional services organization focused on providing solutions with real business value. We provide a customer-focused approach to building authentic partnerships with our clients.


We are seeking a VFX Artist to join the team supporting an international world-wide gaming client and the next‑generation evolution of the franchise

This role will focus on real‑time VFX for core gameplay and visuals, helping deliver next‑gen quality while meeting sprint‑based production needs.


We’re looking for someone with a strong sense of dramatic, dynamic visual effects, a critical eye for timing and motion, and the technical ability to bring these effects to life inside Unreal Engine.

You’ll work closely with a small, collaborative team, contribute to a mix of styles ranging from stylized to ESPN‑inspired sports broadcast polish, and help push the Client's visuals forward.


In This Role, You Will:


  • Execute high‑quality real‑time VFX for the client.
  • Create all necessary art for visual effects, including concepts, prototypes, textures, materials, and final in‑game FX.
  • Develop effects across a wide range of styles, from realistic to stylized, with an emphasis on high‑energy gameplay readability.
  • Contribute to next‑gen arena visuals, gameplay moments (flips, jumps, boosts, grabs), and new core‑loop effects.
  • Work within Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven systems.
  • Collaborate with engineers, artists, and designers to ensure FX integrate smoothly into gameplay and pipelines.
  • Support sprint deliverables and production deadlines leading up to major milestones.


About the Project:


This role helps support Project Coronado, a next‑gen porting of the core Gaming experience, with:


  • Updated visuals for arenas and core gameplay elements.
  • A shift toward ESPN-style, sports-broadcast-inspired VFX, with less traditional arcade styling.
  • A focus on scripting-heavy FX behaviors and technical implementation.
  • No cosmetics work — purely gameplay and core experience.
  • August delivery milestones requiring additional mid‑level VFX support.


Day-to-Day Responsibilities


  • Primarily execution-focused work rather than high-concept ideation.
  • Implementing technical FX solutions using Blueprints, shaders, logic systems, and materials.
  • Creating textures and materials as needed to support FX systems.
  • Working cross-functionally with a small, agile team.
  • Contributing to a live service pipeline with frequent iteration and updates.


Requirements


  • Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating high-quality real-time VFX.
  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred).
  • Experience with Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven FX.
  • Solid technical background paired with strong artistic instincts.
  • Experience working on live service or active production projects.
  • Ability to create all components needed for VFX (textures, meshes, materials, prototypes).
  • Strong sense of timing, weight, animation principles, and motion.
  • Eager to keep learning.


Nice to have


  • Experience with Call of Duty–style FX sensibilities (timing, punch, clarity).
  • Strong animation fundamentals — especially movement, impact, and timing.
  • Experience shipping multiple titles in the game industry.
  • Desire to grow pipelines, tools, and collaborative processes.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.


What You’ll Do

·       Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

·       Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

·        Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

·        5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·        Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·        Brazil-based ( fully remote )

·        Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·        Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·        Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

·        Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

·        High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

·        Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings


How to Apply

Submit your CV  in English , and  one paragraph  describing how you would approach the  first 60 days after a new client’s go-live  in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). ·       Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap

·        5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·        Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product

·        High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Manager to join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.


Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Digital Experience Solution Architect
description:
Join Toptal’s Elite Network of Freelance Talent

Toptal is an exclusive network of the world’s top freelance software developers, designers, finance experts, product managers, and project managers. As one of the fastest-growing fully remote networks globally, we empower professionals to thrive in their freelance careers while working with leading companies around the world.


About the Client

Our client is a global consumer goods leader dedicated to developing essential products, with a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and responsible manufacturing.


Role: Digital Experience Solution Architect

Seeking an experienced Digital Experience Architect to lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and high-performing brand websites. This role drives technical strategy, personalization, and compliance across digital platforms while mentoring teams and fostering innovation.


About the Role

This is a high-impact role within a global consumer goods company, focused on modernizing digital brand experiences through MACH architecture and cloud-native solutions. The digital team is transitioning legacy platforms to composable, API-first environments to improve speed, performance, and personalization. Collaboration across marketing, legal, compliance, and engineering functions is essential to align technical architecture with business goals and regulatory standards. The team prioritizes innovation, sustainability, and inclusivity, with strong support for career development and hybrid work flexibility.


Task and Deliverables

  • Architect and implement scalable, secure digital solutions for global brand websites
  • Lead the transition to modern CMS systems using MACH principles (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless)
  • Integrate personalization tools and performance optimization techniques to drive measurable business outcomes
  • Ensure compliance with global privacy regulations (CPRA/CCPA, GDPR) and lead consent and data protection architecture
  • Maintain architectural documentation including roadmaps, runbooks, and system diagrams.
  • Provide full-stack technical leadership across frontend (React) and backend systems
  • Guide teams on technology selection, architecture best practices, and compliance integration
  • Ensure uptime and reliability through proactive monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • Mentor team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence
  • Support legacy systems during phased migration to modern architecture


Requirements


Must Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital platforms
  • Expertise in full-stack development (React frontend, CMS/backend, API-first integration)
  • Strong knowledge of MACH architecture and modern CMS platforms (headless and traditional)
  • Experience with Azure or AWS and cloud-native deployments
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, SQL, and web security best practices
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and real-time personalization
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and event-based customer interaction flows
  • Exposure to eCommerce platforms and digital marketing technologies


Additional Details

  • Location: Remote in Brazil or Argentina
  • Type: 40h/week Contract
  • Duration: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)
  • Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in their country of residence without employer sponsorship

The digital team is transitioning legacy platforms to composable, API-first environments to improve speed, performance, and personalization. Collaboration across marketing, legal, compliance, and engineering functions is essential to align technical architecture with business goals and regulatory standards. The team prioritizes innovation, sustainability, and inclusivity, with strong support for career development and hybrid work flexibility.


Task and Deliverables

  • Architect and implement scalable, secure digital solutions for global brand websites
  • Lead the transition to modern CMS systems using MACH principles (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless)
  • Integrate personalization tools and performance optimization techniques to drive measurable business outcomes
  • Ensure compliance with global privacy regulations (CPRA/CCPA, GDPR) and lead consent and data protection architecture
  • Maintain architectural documentation including roadmaps, runbooks, and system diagrams.
  • Provide full-stack technical leadership across frontend (React) and backend systems
  • Guide teams on technology selection, architecture best practices, and compliance integration
  • Ensure uptime and reliability through proactive monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • Mentor team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence
  • Support legacy systems during phased migration to modern architecture


Requirements


Must Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital platforms
  • Expertise in full-stack development (React frontend, CMS/backend, API-first integration)
  • Strong knowledge of MACH architecture and modern CMS platforms (headless and traditional)
  • Experience with Azure or AWS and cloud-native deployments
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, SQL, and web security best practices
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and real-time personalization
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and event-based customer interaction flows
  • Exposure to eCommerce platforms and digital marketing technologies


Additional Details

  • Location: Remote in Brazil or Argentina
  • Type: 40h/week Contract
  • Duration: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)
  • Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in their country of residence without employer sponsorship

title: Consulting Partner
description:
ERA Group, a global leader in cost management and business optimisation, is looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to join our international network of consultants.

This is not a traditional consultancy role; it’s a chance to run your own practice within a global brand, with the freedom to shape your market, build your team, and grow your client base while backed by ERA’s proven methodologies, tools, and worldwide community.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries
  • Build and grow your client portfolio through business development and long-term partnerships
  • Take ownership of your practice’s strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership
  • Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation


What You Bring

  • Extensive consulting or senior leadership experience in cost management, procurement, or performance improvement
  • A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery
  • Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics
  • Confidence in engaging with CxO-level stakeholders and leveraging your professional network
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the ambition to grow a successful consulting practice



This is the ideal next step if you’re seeking less bureaucracy, more independence, and the chance to build something of your own within a global consultancy platform.

title: Specialist, Project Finance and M&A, LATAM
description:
About the Company:


Recurrent Energy is one of the world’s largest and most geographically diversified utility-scale solar and energy storage project development, ownership, and operations platforms. With an industry-leading team of in-house energy experts, we are a wholly-owned subsidiary of Canadian Solar Inc. and function as Canadian Solar’s global development and power services business.


About the Position:


The Project Finance and M&A Specialist will play a critical role in supporting the company’s growth across LATAM by performing advanced financial analysis, developing robust financial models, and assisting in the structuring and execution of complex transactions. Working closely with the Project Finance and M&A team, this role provides analytical, strategic, and execution support throughout the transaction lifecycle — from origination and due diligence to closing and portfolio management.


Responsibilities:


  • Business Acumen and Financial Literacy - Demonstrates an understanding of relevant financial metrics and concepts.
  • Resource Planning - Plans for various possible timelines and contingencies for completing assigned work.
  • Collaborative - Displays positive demeanor in interactions with others both on the team and cross-functionally.
  • Project Structuring & Execution – Understands the legal, technical, and financial components of project finance structures; effectively contributes to transaction execution from term sheet to financial close.
  • Communication & Influence – Clearly articulates financial insights and recommendations; influences decision-making through well-reasoned analysis.
  • Results Orientation – Drives deliverables to completion with a focus on accuracy, timeliness, and value creation.
  • Adaptability & Learning Agility – Quickly assimilates new information, adjusts to changing deal dynamics, and continuously seeks to enhance technical and market knowledge.
  • Leadership & Mentoring – Provides guidance to junior members, reviews work outputs, and helps raise the overall quality of the team’s deliverables.


Qualifications and Experience:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in project finance, M&A, or a similar role.
  • Proficiency in financial modeling tools (Excel, VBA).
  • Experience in cross-border transactions within LATAM markets.
  • Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently and take ownership of complex workstreams.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, capable of explaining technical results to financial stakeholders.

title: Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno
description:
Descrição da Empresa Handcom é especializada em fornecer soluções de software para gestão de armazéns e centros de distribuição. Com o nosso sistema Mobilize WMS, oferecemos uma solução completa para otimizar e gerenciar eficientemente as operações logísticas dos nossos clientes. A Handcom também fornece soluções de gestão de ativos e inventários utilizando RFID através do Mobilize IoT. Fundada em 2007, temos casos de sucesso reconhecidos no mercado nacional e somos premiados pela Fundação Nacional da Qualidade com o prêmio faixa ouro. Nosso propósito é empoderar pessoas que movem o mundo para o futuro.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações .Net, garantindo performance e qualidade do código. As responsabilidades incluem a implementação de novas funcionalidades no sistema, realização de testes, depuração e otimização . Este é um cargo de tempo integral dedicado e remoto.


Experiências Exigidas – Desenvolvedor Pleno .NET C#

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end com .NET/C#

  • Vivência prática de pelo menos 3 anos  atuando em projetos profissionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços com ASP.NET Core .


Excelência em acesso a dados com Entity Framework Core

  • Experiência em criação, manutenção e otimização de consultas LINQ e SQL.
  • Uso avançado de migrations, mapeamento de entidades e relações complexas.
  • Ajuste de performance em queries e análise de planos de execução.


Prática em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful

  • Implementação de endpoints seguros, versionados e performáticos.
  • Integração com sistemas externos e consumo de serviços.
  • Documentação de APIs (Swagger, OpenAPI).


Aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software

  • Experiência comprovada com Clean Code, SOLID e princípios de design .
  • Criação de código escalável, legível e sustentável.
  • Participação em code reviews  e manutenção de padrões de qualidade.


Experiência em análise de performance e troubleshooting

  • Identificação e resolução de gargalos de performance em aplicações e banco de dados.
  • Uso de ferramentas de profiling e análise de logs.
  • Experiência em logs estruturados e telemetria  (Application Insights, Serilog, Sentry, etc.).


Vivência em times ágeis

  • Experiência trabalhando em squads com Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Participação em cerimônias (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva).
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa em ambientes distribuídos/remotos.


    • Experiências Desejáveis (não obrigatórias, mas valorizadas)
    • Projetos com DDD (Domain-Driven Design) , eventos de domínio e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus).
    • Experiência implementando estratégias de resiliência  (retry, fallback, circuit breaker).
    • Projetos de monitoramento avançado com telemetria e métricas de performance.
    • Participação em arquiteturas escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade.



    Diferenciais
    • Ter trabalhado com Ext.js  em sistemas legados.
    • Experiência em Blazor  (Server ou WebAssembly).
    • Portfólio com projetos relevantes em produção.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados SR - Sustentação Open Finance
description:
A ATRA está em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados para atuar na sustentação, monitoramento e operação de um ambiente crítico de Open Finance em GCP , garantindo alta confiabilidade, estabilidade operacional e atendimento a requisitos regulatórios, operacionais e de segurança.


Descrição da vaga:

O projeto de Open Finance tem como objetivo garantir a ingestão, processamento, monitoramento e disponibilidade de dados financeiros em ambiente Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Devido à criticidade do ecossistema e à necessidade de alta confiabilidade dos pipelines de dados, o(a) profissional atuará diretamente na operação e sustentação do ambiente, assegurando rápida resposta a incidentes, estabilidade contínua e suporte às áreas envolvidas.


Responsabilidades:

O(a) profissional atuará de ponta a ponta na sustentação do ambiente, incluindo:

- Monitoramento contínuo de pipelines de dados (batch e on-demand).

- Atuação imediata em falhas operacionais e incidentes críticos.

- Análise de logs e troubleshooting em Dataproc, pipelines e DAGs.

- Acompanhamento de cargas, reprocessamentos e validações de dados.

- Interface com times de Engenharia, Arquitetura, Governança e Negócio.

- Apoio em processos de estabilização e melhoria contínua.

- Documentação de incidentes, análises de causa raiz e planos de ação.


Requisitos Técnicos Necessários:

- Experiência sólida com Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

- Domínio de BigQuery (modelagem, performance e gestão de custos).

- Experiência com Dataproc / Apache Spark.

- Vivência com pipelines batch e reprocessamentos.

- Análise de logs e falhas em pipelines de dados.

- Conhecimento em IAM e gestão de permissões.

- Experiência em ambientes críticos ou regulados.

- Continuous Query: processamento contínuo e atualização incremental de dados (streaming ou near real-time).

- Pub/Sub: integração e monitoramento de pipelines orientados a eventos.

- Cloud SQL (MySQL): operação, suporte e análise de bases relacionais.

- Cloud Functions: suporte e manutenção de funções serverless orientadas a eventos.

- Cloud Run: operação e monitoramento de aplicações containerizadas em ambiente serverless.

- Cloud Composer (Airflow): monitoramento, análise e suporte a DAGs, incluindo falhas e reprocessamentos.

- MongoDB: consulta, análise e suporte a bases NoSQL.

- Experiência com metodologias ágeis.


Requisitos Técnicos — Desejáveis:

- Experiência prévia com Open Finance.

- Conhecimento ou experiência com DBT.

- Requisitos Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

- Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em ambientes críticos.

- Comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e não técnicas.

- Proatividade e forte senso de ownership.

- Organização, disciplina e foco em documentação.


Modelo de Trabalho e Contratação

- Contratação: PJ

- Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Benefícios ATRA:

- TotalPass

- Reembolso 100% em certificações

- Parcerias educacionais

- Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas

- Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta


Sobre a ATRA:

Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. Atuamos com grandes empresas e somos parceiros de líderes como Google, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, Denodo e BigID. Trabalhamos com tecnologia, mas nosso foco sempre é gente.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Us


Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


We’re building the infrastructure that powers smarter agency discovery, matchmaking, and evaluation—and we’re looking for a developer who wants real ownership over how that system is built and evolves.


⸻


The Role


As Vendry’s Developer, you’ll be responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving the core technical infrastructure that powers the Vendry platform. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership across frontend, backend, and internal tooling.


You’ll manage everything from our public-facing website and landing pages to our agency portal and proprietary agency search engine. You’ll work closely with the founding team to ship features quickly, improve performance and reliability, and help shape the technical direction of the product.


This is an ideal role for a developer who thrives in early-stage environments, enjoys autonomy, and is excited to build and iterate fast.


⸻


Responsibilities

• Own and manage Vendry’s full technical stack, including:

• Frontend website and marketing landing pages

• Agency portal and internal tools

• Proprietary agency search and matchmaking engine

• Build, ship, and maintain new features across the product with a focus on speed, quality, and scalability.

• Ensure the platform is reliable, performant, and secure as usage grows.

• Collaborate closely with product, operations, and leadership to translate business needs into technical solutions.

• Stay up to date on modern development trends, tools, and best practices.

• Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to improve velocity and code quality.

• Troubleshoot issues across the stack and proactively improve system architecture.

• Document technical decisions and maintain clean, readable codebases.


⸻


Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience as a software developer or engineer.

• Experience working in a startup environment is a must.

• Strong experience with modern frontend and backend development.

• Comfortable owning projects end-to-end, from idea to production.

• Familiarity with databases, APIs, and search or filtering systems is a plus.

• Experience building or maintaining SaaS products or internal platforms is strongly preferred.

• Curious, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and clear written communication.


⸻


Compensation

• Salary: $2,000–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and scope.

• Full-time, remote role.


⸻


Why Join Vendry


Joining Vendry means having real ownership over a product that’s redefining how brands find agency partners. You won’t be maintaining a tiny slice of a massive codebase—you’ll be shaping the foundation of a growing platform.


  • We’re a small, fast-moving team that values initiative, clarity of thinking, and building practical solutions that actually get used. If you enjoy shipping, iterating, and seeing your work directly impact the business, you’ll feel right at home.

title: Cientista de Dados SR
description:
A Atos é líder global em transformação digital, com 112 mil colaboradores em 73 países e receita anual de €12 bilhões. Há mais de 30 anos no Brasil conectando pessoas, negócios e tecnologia para ajudar a melhorar o mundo em que vivemos.


Perfil da Vaga:

Buscamos um(a) Cientista de Dados para atuar em projetos estratégicos de inovação, integrando inteligência artificial, ciência de dados e pesquisa aplicada ao desenvolvimento de soluções na indústria química.


Contratação: Cooperado

Duração: 12 meses (com possibilidade de renovação)


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver modelos preditivos e redes neurais aplicados aos projetos.
  • Criar e manter documentação estatística e técnica.
  • Utilizar algoritmos de machine learning, deep learning e análise estatística.
  • Realizar coleta, limpeza, enriquecimento, estruturação e validação de dados.
  • Executar análises exploratórias baseadas em inferência estatística para identificação de padrões e insights relevantes.
  • Atuar com modelagem preditiva, segmentação e análise de anomalias.
  • Desenvolver estudos de caso com análise descritiva.
  • Aplicar conceitos de matemática, estatística e aprendizado de máquina no desenvolvimento das soluções.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência com linguagens e ferramentas: R, Python, SPSS e SAS .
  • Conhecimento em machine learning, deep learning e redes neurais .
  • Experiência em ambientes on-premises e/ou cloud .
  • Sólida base em matemática e estatística aplicada .



Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Por isso, independentemente da sua identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, cidadania ou qualquer outro aspecto que o torne único, inscreva-se!


Aviso de privacidade

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos. Caso haja alguma dúvida em relação à privacidade dos dados ou qualquer aspecto relacionado ao tratamento realizado, você pode entrar em contato por meio do canal: Acesse o nosso aviso de privacidade para saber mais sobre o tratamento de dados pessoais realizado pela Atos:

title: Advogado(a) Pleno
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Advogado(a) Pleno , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades

  • Analisar, elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos diversos, incluindo prestação de serviços, fornecedores, clientes, parcerias, confidencialidade (NDA), aditivos e distratos, com autonomia técnica;
  • Identificar riscos jurídicos contratuais e contenciosos, propondo soluções juridicamente seguras e alinhadas às diretrizes e interesses da empresa;
  • Apoiar as áreas internas por meio da elaboração de pareceres, orientações jurídicas e esclarecimentos técnicos, atuando como parceiro do negócio;
  • Elaborar e revisar peças processuais de média complexidade, como petições iniciais, contestações, recursos e manifestações diversas;
  • Acompanhar processos judiciais cíveis, massificados e estratégicos, em todas as instâncias, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e a qualidade técnica das entregas;
  • Realizar análises de risco processual e contratual, sugerindo estratégias de defesa, acordos e mitigação de contingências;
  • Gerenciar carteira de processos, com controle organizado e atualização contínua dos sistemas internos de gestão jurídica;
  • Atuar na interface com escritórios terceirizados, acompanhando prazos, revisando peças e alinhando estratégias sob orientação da liderança jurídica;
  • Monitorar e analisar alterações legislativas e jurisprudenciais relevantes, especialmente relacionadas ao setor financeiro, avaliando impactos práticos para a empresa;
  • Apoiar a elaboração de relatórios gerenciais, apresentações e indicadores jurídicos, contribuindo para a tomada de decisão.


Requisitos

  • Graduação completa em Direito, com registro ativo na OAB;
  • Sólida experiência com contratos, contencioso cível e rotinas societárias básicas;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de gestão processual, sistemas jurídicos e soluções de inteligência artificial aplicadas ao jurídico;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica, organização e elaboração de peças processuais de média complexidade;
  • Experiência no relacionamento com escritórios terceirizados e gestão de prazos;
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com capacidade de interação com diferentes áreas da empresa.
  • Experiência atuando na área jurídica em ambientes corporativos.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência atuando em grandes escritórios.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.


O que oferecemos:

  • Analisar, elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos diversos, incluindo prestação de serviços, fornecedores, clientes, parcerias, confidencialidade (NDA), aditivos e distratos, com autonomia técnica;
  • Identificar riscos jurídicos contratuais e contenciosos, propondo soluções juridicamente seguras e alinhadas às diretrizes e interesses da empresa;
  • Apoiar as áreas internas por meio da elaboração de pareceres, orientações jurídicas e esclarecimentos técnicos, atuando como parceiro do negócio;
  • Elaborar e revisar peças processuais de média complexidade, como petições iniciais, contestações, recursos e manifestações diversas;
  • Acompanhar processos judiciais cíveis, massificados e estratégicos, em todas as instâncias, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e a qualidade técnica das entregas;
  • Realizar análises de risco processual e contratual, sugerindo estratégias de defesa, acordos e mitigação de contingências;

  • Atuar na interface com escritórios terceirizados, acompanhando prazos, revisando peças e alinhando estratégias sob orientação da liderança jurídica;

  • Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong foundation in marketing analytics , with hands-on experience analyzing multi-channel marketing performance.
  • Advanced SQL expertise , including complex queries over large datasets with performance considerations.

  • Experience in fast-paced or data-heavy environments.
  • Strong communication skills and comfort presenting insights to non-technical audiences.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Pricing or Computer Vision) 100% Remote, Fluent English (required)


Brazil-based | PJ Contract | Long-term


We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team on a long-term, fully remote PJ contract . This is a global environment with international stakeholders, and fluency in English is mandatory , as all communication and interviews are conducted in English.


This role is open to Brazil-based professionals with strong experience in Pricing/Optimization or Computer Vision , who are passionate about building and deploying production-grade ML systems that drive real business impact.


What you’ll do


  • Lead the development and deployment of Machine Learning solutions to solve complex business problems
  • Own key components of ML systems, influencing technical direction and architectural decisions
  • Develop clean, efficient, and scalable production-grade code
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to generate actionable insights
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies to build robust and scalable models
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders
  • Mentor junior team members and help grow domain expertise within the team
  • Contribute to the company’s technical leadership through research, publications, or patents


Minimum Requirements


  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s Degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and maintaining ML/DL models in production at scale
  • Strong understanding of ML best practices (feature engineering, A/B testing, experiment design, training & serving pipelines)
  • Hands-on experience with ML algorithms and techniques (gradient boosting, deep neural networks, optimization, regularization)
  • Experience in at least one of the following domains:
  • Pricing / price estimation, personalization, recommender systems, computer vision, fraud detection & authentication, or marketing
  • Strong Python skills and experience with scientific and ML libraries (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch)
  • Solid data engineering experience with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with Big Data tools such as Spark, Kafka, Apache Beam
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure )
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, or related field
  • Experience applying ML to real-world business problems, preferably in retail or e-commerce
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and pipelines
  • Strong sense of ownership, impact-driven mindset, and passion for high-quality ML solutions


Why join us

  • 100% remote work (Brazil-based)
  • Long-term PJ contract
  • Flexible working hours aligned with Brazil time
  • Opportunity to work on impactful ML systems in a global environment
  • Strong technical ownership and growth opportunities

title: Backend Software Engineer - Rust (Mid/Senior)
description:
At eNor Securities , we are a fintech focused on financial infrastructure, digital assets, and regulated products , operating at the intersection of traditional finance and the crypto ecosystem.

We work in a highly complex technical and regulatory environment , where engineering decisions have a direct impact on security, scalability, reliability, and operations .

Our engineering team works closely with product and business, with technical autonomy, ownership, and a strong focus on long-term sustainable solutions .

About the role

We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer with a strong focus on Rust , at Mid to Senior level , to play a strategic role in the evolution of our backend systems.

We seek someone with a software architecture mindset , capable of actively participating in technical decisions, evaluating trade-offs, and contributing to the evolution of our codebase with maturity and long-term vision, in close collaboration with the Tech Lead and engineering team.

Beyond feature implementation, this role is key to structuring, scaling, and sustaining the platform as our products grow.

Expected profile
  • Mid to Senior level
  • 5+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong architectural thinking
  • Comfortable discussing, proposing, and executing technical decisions
  • Hands-on, collaborative, and critical-thinking mindset
  • Technical English for reading, writing, and professional communication
Required skills
  • Solid experience with Rust
  • Consistent practice of Test Driven Development (TDD)
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices architecture
  • Ability to analyze and contribute to architectural decisions
  • Experience or strong interest in fintech, crypto, or financial systems (highly valued)
Nice to have
  • Async Rust / Tokio
  • gRPC (Tonic)
  • SQLx
  • Redis
  • Kafka
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
Responsibilities
  • Contribute to backend architectural evolution
  • Implement solutions aligned with team decisions
  • Propose improvements in architecture, performance, and quality
  • Ensure robust, testable, and maintainable code
  • Collaborate closely with the Tech Lead on technical decisions
  • Support ongoing maintenance and evolution of services
Differentials
  • Experience in regulated environments or critical systems
  • Background in high-scale, high-availability, or low-latency systems
  • Previous experience in mature engineering teams
  • Senior engineer mindset with a collaborative and systemic view

I f you enjoy real technical challenges and want to build impactful financial infrastructure, come join eNor Securities.

title: Analytics Architect - Azure
description:
Job Title: Analytics Architect

Location: Remote

Duration: Contract


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Analytics Architect to lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics and big data solutions on the Azure platform. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in Azure Databricks/Fabric, big data technologies, and cloud-based data engineering, with a proven ability to translate business requirements into scalable analytics solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and IT teams to gather requirements and deliver effective data solutions.
  • Oversee end-to-end implementation of data platforms, ensuring alignment with business needs and industry best practices.
  • Design and develop scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and related tools.
  • Integrate Azure Databricks with Azure services such as Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory, and on-premise systems.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to data engineers and developers.
  • Ensure documentation of architectures, processes, and data flows.
  • Enforce best practices for code quality, performance, scalability, data security, and governance.
  • Stay current with emerging Databricks and Azure analytics technologies to drive innovation.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks (cluster management, notebooks, Delta Lake).
  • Proficiency in big data technologies such as Spark and Hadoop.
  • Strong experience with PySpark and SQL.
  • Deep knowledge of Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse Analytics, and Azure Data Factory.
  • Experience with data warehousing, data lakes, and ETL/ELT architectures.
  • Familiarity with Power BI, SSRS, and SSAS.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control tools (Git).
  • Knowledge of cloud security, data governance, and compliance best practices.

title: Java Developer | Mid
description:
Você fará parte da Compass UOL, uma empresa global que integra o grupo AI/R Comany ! Atuamos na transformação digital de organizações, ajudando-as a inovar e alcançar resultados de impacto.

Desenvolvemos plataformas digitais e soluções que impulsionam negócios, promovendo eficiência, escalabilidade e experiências diferenciadas.

Com foco em atrair e desenvolver os melhores talentos, criamos oportunidades que transformam vidas e reforçam o papel positivo da tecnologia na sociedade.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Você fará parte de um projeto desafiador, com foco em novas tecnologias, atuando como back-end no apoio à implementação de soluções de IA dentro da equipe;
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de APIs em Java Spring Boot;
  • Participar da evolução do produto trazendo ideias e melhorias;
  • O time é responsável por desenvolver novas integrações com a área de marketing e dar sustentação às integrações já existentes, com foco em disponibilizar ao cliente as melhores ofertas, utilizando Spring IA e engenharia de prompts;


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida com Java e com o ecossistema Spring (Spring IA, Spring Data, etc)
  • Experiência com Spring IA e engenharia de prompts.
  • Conhecimento em Python (funções, escopos, lambdas, OOP, criação de APIs com FastAPI);
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de agentes (Strands, CrewAI).
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de transações e familiaridade com DynamoDB, Redis, Oracle e PostgreSQL;
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microserviços;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas distribuídos;
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de observabilidade (NewRelic, Open Telemetry ou Dynatrace, Splunk).

title: Desenvolvedor Front end SR
description:
Código da vaga: 57077


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, Desenvolvedor Fron end - venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Experiência com Angular (versões mais atuais)

Experiência com React

Experiência em Next.js

Experiência em Amazon AWS

Experiência em GitHub (versionamento e colaboração)

WebView


Responsabilidades:

Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações front-end de alta performance

Trabalhar em conjunto com times de produto, UX e back-end para construção de soluções escaláveis Garantir qualidade de código, boas práticas e manutenibilidade

Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e decisões técnicas


Modelo 100% home office

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions
